newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin meets Chernomyrdin after heart operation.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin meets Chernomyrdin after heart operation.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, recovering from open heart surgery, met Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin for 15 minutes on Wednesday, a Kremlin press statement said.

It was Yeltsin's first official meeting for more than a week and the president told Chernomyrdin, who deputised for him during Tuesday's operation, that he was determined to return to work as soon as possible. The meeting took place in the Cardiology Research Centre where surgery took place.
